probes.What is an artificial neural network?:
An **artificial neural network (ANN)** is a computational model inspired by the structure and function of the human brain. It consists of interconnected nodes (or neurons) organized in layers—typically input, hidden, and output layers—where each connection has an associated weight. These networks process data by passing it through layers of weighted connections, using mathematical functions (such as activation functions) to transform the input into an output.
